title: 个人防护装备的选择
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/021_个人防护装备的选择.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/021_个人防护装备的选择/src.py

points.K3: 选错防护比不戴更危险
points.K6: 防护区域和防护用品存放处
points.K9: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换
points.K11: 缺了用错，及时报告补齐
points.S1: 围裙、袖套等其他防护用品

shots.scene: 欣欣面前摆着安全帽、护目镜、手套、实验服和安全鞋，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a table with a safety helmet, safety goggles, gloves, a lab coat and safety shoes, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲个人防护装备的选择。

shots.scene: 防护用品在人形轮廓上对应头、眼、手、身、脚
shots.prompt_en: Protective equipment icons line up beside a body outline: head, eyes, hands, body and feet. No people.
shots.narration: 从头到脚，该怎么选？

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜子里随手抓了一副手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a random pair of gloves from a cabinet without looking.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手拿了副手套就要上手。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a reagent bottle on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研问：这手套挡得住这种试剂吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰：手套不都一样吗？

shots.scene: 风险评估表和一套防护用品之间连着箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links a blank risk assessment form to a set of protective equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 戴什么防护，由风险评估决定。

shots.scene: 安全技术说明书翻到防护那一页
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet opened to a page with protective equipment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 先查安全技术说明书的防护建议。

shots.scene: 化学品和实验条件两个图标，汇成一套防护
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a chemical bottle and a heating setup, merge into one set of protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 按用到的化学品和实验条件来定。

shots.scene: 讲台上没有化学品，讲解人不穿防护
shots.prompt_en: A presenter stands at a clean demonstration table with no chemicals on it. No faces.
shots.narration: 撤走所有化学品，才谈得上不穿防护。

shots.scene: 小研在纸上列出危害和受伤部位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a list on a blank form, with body part icons beside it.
shots.narration: 先写下来：有哪些危害、伤哪儿。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教，老周指着清单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man, who points at a checklist.
shots.narration: 不确定的，问清导师。

shots.scene: 出事怎么办的应急图标：洗眼器、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Emergency icons of an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher light up. No people.
shots.narration: 顺便想好：出了事怎么应急。

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 一副薄手套挡不住液体，旁边一个笑脸被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A thin glove lets liquid soak through, next to a smiling face icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 选错防护，比不戴还危险。
overlay: 选错防护比不戴更危险

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 人形图标被假的盾牌罩着，盾牌有裂缝
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram stands behind a fake shield with cracks in it. No people.
shots.narration: 它让人以为自己很安全。

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 打勾表格被打叉，旁边是对准危害的防护
shots.prompt_en: A tick-box form is crossed out, beside protective gear matched to a specific hazard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不是打勾表演，要对准危害。

shots.scene: 人形轮廓：眼、手、呼吸、身体依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A body outline lights up at the eyes, hands, breathing zone and body in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 眼、手、呼吸、身体，各有各的防护。

shots.scene: 液氮罐旁一副防冻手套
shots.prompt_en: A pair of cryogenic gloves next to a liquid nitrogen dewar. No people.
shots.narration: 取液氮，要戴防冻手套。

shots.scene: 手套盒上的化学品图标和说明书对照
shots.prompt_en: A glove box with a chemical icon is compared against a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 手套材质，按化学品和说明来选。

shots.scene: 有害气体图标旁呼吸防护，泄漏图标旁全身防护服
shots.prompt_en: A respirator next to a toxic gas icon, and a full-body protective suit next to a spill icon. No people.
shots.narration: 特殊工作，换上专门的防护。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套三件摆在一起
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat, safety goggles and a pair of gloves laid out together. No people.
shots.narration: 一般实验，三件必不可少。

shots.scene: 一个人形图标缺了护目镜，问号
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram in a lab coat and gloves but missing goggles, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看看这位，少了什么？

shots.scene: 防护挡住飞溅，同时样品也没被污染
shots.prompt_en: Protective gear blocks a splash, and a sample dish stays clean beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 防护护人，也护样品。

shots.section_title: 防护区域和防护用品存放处
shots.scene: 实验室门口的必须戴护目镜和必须戴手套标志
shots.prompt_en: A mandatory eye protection sign and a mandatory gloves sign on a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 进门先看标志，按要求穿戴。
overlay: 防护区域和防护用品存放处

shots.section_title: 防护区域和防护用品存放处
shots.scene: 地面画线的防护区域示意
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with a marked zone where protective equipment is required. No people.
shots.narration: 规定的防护区域，一步也不能少。

shots.section_title: 防护区域和防护用品存放处
shots.scene: 防护用品集中存放柜
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet storing goggles, gloves and lab coats in neat rows. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品放在哪，要心里有数。

shots.scene: 王老师给实验室发放合格的防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out boxes of protective equipment to the lab.
shots.narration: 学校和实验室，按规定配齐防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰接过护目镜，自己戴好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes the goggles and puts them on himself.
shots.narration: 穿对、戴好、保持完好，是你的事。

shots.scene: 必须图标和自愿图标对比，自愿被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mandatory blue circle icon with a green check next to an optional icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 这是硬要求，不是想戴才戴。

shots.scene: 人戴着不合身的护目镜，汗流满面，偷偷摘下
shots.prompt_en: A person wearing oversized goggles sweats and secretly takes them off. No faces.
shots.narration: 不合身、太闷热，人就会偷偷摘。

shots.scene: 疲劳、出汗、烦躁三个图标指向失误
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, tiredness, sweat and irritation, point to a mistake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 过热、厌烦，也会让人出错。

shots.scene: 货架上大、中、小号依次排开
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of gloves and coats in small, medium and large sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 尺码要齐，合身才愿意穿。

shots.scene: 戴眼镜的人戴上罩式护目镜，调松紧带
shots.prompt_en: A person wearing glasses puts on over-the-glasses goggles and adjusts the strap. No faces.
shots.narration: 戴眼镜的，选能罩住眼镜的。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 【实拍】用前检查护目镜镜片和手套有无破损（桌面固定机位，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands inspect goggle lenses for scratches and a glove for holes before use.
shots.narration: 用前先检查，有没有破损。
overlay: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 镜片划花、面屏开裂、手套破洞被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Scratched lenses, a cracked face shield and a torn glove, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 划花、开裂、破洞，都要换新。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 手套沾上液滴，立即更换
shots.prompt_en: A drop lands on a glove, which is immediately taken off and replaced. No faces.
shots.narration: 可能被污染，马上更换。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 一天中的时钟，防护用品状态被反复查看
shots.prompt_en: A clock moves through the day while a person pictogram checks its gloves again. No people.
shots.narration: 一整天，都要留意它的状况。

shots.scene: 清洁后的护目镜单独装袋存放
shots.prompt_en: Cleaned goggles are placed into a bag and stored in a personal slot. No people.
shots.narration: 用完清洁，妥善存放。

shots.scene: 储物格贴着不同的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Storage slots marked with different person pictograms, one item per slot. No people.
shots.narration: 能专人专用的，专人专用。

shots.scene: 穿和脱的箭头顺序示意
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows show the order of putting on and taking off protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 按顺序穿戴，按顺序脱下。

shots.scene: 脱下时不碰外表面，脱完洗手
shots.prompt_en: Gloves are peeled off without touching the outer surface, then hands are washed. No faces.
shots.narration: 脱时别碰外面，脱完洗手。

shots.section_title: 缺了用错，及时报告补齐
shots.scene: 穿戴不对的人形图标，盾牌失效
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram wearing gear incorrectly, with a broken shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴不对，等于没戴。
overlay: 缺了用错，及时报告补齐

shots.section_title: 缺了用错，及时报告补齐
shots.scene: 空了的手套盒，阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows an empty glove box to the older man.
shots.narration: 用品缺了，及时报告，补齐再做。

shots.section_title: 缺了用错，及时报告补齐
shots.scene: 一个人不戴防护，旁边皱眉的同事
shots.prompt_en: A person without protective gear works while coworkers frown. No faces.
shots.narration: 不戴、戴不对，最显得不专业。

shots.scene: 计时器显示一分钟，护目镜被放在一边，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A timer showing one minute while goggles are left aside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: “就一分钟”，最容易不戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 再短的操作也飞溅，护目镜挡住
shots.prompt_en: A quick task still causes a splash, which is stopped by goggles. No faces.
shots.narration: 再短的操作，防护也不能省。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验室巡查，记下问题
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab observing work and notes an issue.
shots.narration: 在真实操作中查，趁早发现偏离。

shots.scene: 老李戴好安全帽进入施工的实验楼
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a safety helmet before entering a lab building under renovation.
shots.narration: 有砸伤、碰头风险，戴安全帽。

shots.scene: 【实拍】调好帽衬松紧、系好下颏带（正面中景，人物不露全脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person adjusts the helmet harness and fastens the chin strap.
shots.narration: 调好帽衬，系好下颏带。

shots.scene: 安全帽被钻孔、贴改装件，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A safety helmet with drilled holes and add-on modifications, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不钻孔、不改装，会削弱强度。

shots.scene: 受过冲击的安全帽放进报废箱
shots.prompt_en: A dented safety helmet is put into a disposal box. No people.
shots.narration: 受过冲击或过期的，要更换。

shots.scene: 四个图标：防砸、防刺穿、防滑、防化学品
shots.prompt_en: Four icons on a safety shoe: a falling weight, a nail, a slippery floor and a chemical drop. No people.
shots.narration: 安全鞋：防砸、防刺、防滑、防化学品。

shots.scene: 防静电鞋和电绝缘鞋分开放
shots.prompt_en: Antistatic shoes and electrically insulating shoes placed separately with different icons. No people.
shots.narration: 防静电鞋和绝缘鞋，不能混用。

shots.scene: 胶靴配钢头，重物落下被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A rubber boot with a protective toe cap stops a falling weight. No people.
shots.narration: 穿胶靴，脚趾照样要防砸。

shots.scene: 焊接车间，熔渣落在劳保鞋上
shots.prompt_en: In a welding workshop, hot spatter falls on sturdy work shoes. No faces.
shots.narration: 搬设备、焊接，穿防砸防烫鞋。

shots.scene: 穿着安全鞋仍远离悬吊重物
shots.prompt_en: A person in safety shoes still keeps away from a hanging load. No faces.
shots.narration: 穿了安全鞋，也不是保险。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔底层的防护亮起，上层也亮着
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer of an inverted pyramid lights up with gloves, while upper layers glow too. No people.
shots.narration: 穿对戴好，能大大减少伤害。

shots.scene: 通风柜、洗眼器图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and an eyewash station light up. No people.
shots.narration: 但光靠防护不够，还要安全设施。

shots.section_title: 围裙、袖套等其他防护用品
shots.scene: 倾倒腐蚀品时系上防化围裙
shots.prompt_en: A person in a lab coat ties on a chemical-resistant apron before pouring a corrosive liquid. No faces.
shots.narration: 大量倾倒腐蚀品，加防化围裙。
overlay: 围裙、袖套等其他防护用品

shots.section_title: 围裙、袖套等其他防护用品
shots.scene: 袖套、隔热手套、耳塞等图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sleeve covers, heat-resistant gloves and ear plugs. No people.
shots.narration: 袖套、隔热手套、耳塞，按需加。

shots.section_title: 围裙、袖套等其他防护用品
shots.scene: 合格标识的包装和无标识包装对比
shots.prompt_en: A package with a quality mark and product label next to an unlabeled package crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 选有合格证明、标识清楚的产品。

shots.scene: 王老师培训学生认识和穿戴防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains students to identify and put on protective equipment.
shots.narration: 上岗前先培训：会选、会穿、会脱。

shots.scene: 学生练习检查和报废判断，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Students practice inspecting gear and sorting damaged items into a disposal box, with green checks. No faces.
shots.narration: 还要会检查，知道什么时候报废。

shots.scene: 评估、选择、检查、使用、维护五个图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five icons get green checks in order: assess, select, inspect, wear and maintain. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估再选择，用前查，用后护。

shots.scene: 从头到脚的防护人形亮起
shots.prompt_en: A body outline lights up from head to feet with matched protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 对准危害，合身好穿，按规定戴。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴上护目镜，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on safety goggles and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲眼面部防护。
